entities.summary: Arab, a notable figure in the history of Uzbekistan, associated with Turkic Period and Early Islam (560–750). Preceded by Western Turkic Khaganate. Their legacy influenced Qutayba ibn Muslim conquers Bukhara and Samarkand for the Umayyad Caliphate and Samanid Bukhara Golden Age.
